dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: The elevation differences in Yilong Wharf are too great, and the water-powered lift is only used to transport large items. It doesn't run often, either.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: Sometimes we just have to take the stairs when we get a job that needs delivering quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: The paths between the upper and lower wharf are designed to be long and winding. Stops them from being steep, but that's extra work for us.

dialogues.speaker: Yougui
dialogues.text: I've heard that the Communications Office is planning on building several small lifts... That will improve the situation, no doubt about it.
